issues.title: Fresh native runtime P2 command probe is blocked
issues.detail: The simulator contract and a read-only pre-existing window prove the expected P1/P2 shape, but a fresh approved-launcher command probe cannot start while protected PID 37884 owns port 5151.
issues.nextAction: After the protected lease is released by its owner, rerun the approved launcher and verify P1 ActionChat, P2 Galaxy order, RequestStep state delta, and same-window ScriptError absence.
